quranTranslation.text: Who is guilty of more wrong than he who forgeth a lie against Allah, or saith: I am inspired, when he is not inspired in aught; and who saith: I will reveal the like of that which Allah hath revealed? If thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers reach the pangs of death and the angels stretch their hands out (saying): Deliver up your souls. This day ye are awarded doom of degradation for that ye spake concerning Allah other than the truth, and used to scorn His portents.

explanation.bs: Meleki govore nepravednicima na samrti: „Izvadite svoje duše!“ – ar-Rāġib: ovdje je nafs isto što i ruh.
explanation.en: The angels say to the wrongdoers at death: “Deliver up your souls.” — ar-Rāġib: here nafs is the rūḥ.

quranTranslation.text: Every soul will taste of death. And ye will be paid on the Day of Resurrection only that which ye have fairly earned. Whoso is removed from the Fire and is made to enter paradise, he indeed is triumphant. The life of this world is but comfort of illusion.

explanation.bs: „Svaka duša će okusiti smrt“ – nafs umire.
explanation.en: “Every soul will taste of death” — the nafs dies.

quranTranslation.text: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

explanation.bs: „A onaj ko se bojao stajanja pred svojim Gospodarom i dušu od strasti suzdržavao…“ – duša koju treba suzdržati.
explanation.en: “But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust…” — the soul that must be held back.

quranTranslation.text: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.

explanation.bs: „Pa kad ga uobličim i udahnem u njega od Moga duha…“ – ar-Rāġib: pripisivanje Allahu je počast, kao ‚Moja Kuća‘.
explanation.en: “So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit…” — ar-Rāġib: the ascription to Allah is one of honour, like ‘My House’.

quranTranslation.text: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

explanation.bs: „S njim je sišao Povjerljivi Duh“ – Džibril, kako ga ar-Rāġib objašnjava.
explanation.en: “Which the True Spirit hath brought down” — Jibrīl, as ar-Rāġib explains.

quranTranslation.text: They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.

explanation.bs: „Pitaju te o duhu. Odgovori: Duh je stvar koja pripada mome Gospodaru“ – ovdje Kur'an njegovu suštinu prepušta Allahu; mufessiri se razilaze oko toga šta se tačno misli.
explanation.en: “They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord” — here the Quran leaves its reality with Allah; mufassirun differ on what exactly is meant.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Fasting is prescribed for you, even as it was prescribed for those before you, that ye may ward off (evil);

explanation.bs: „O vjernici, propisan vam je post, kao što je bio propisan onima prije vas …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za kataba kao obavezu.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Fasting is prescribed for you, even as it was prescribed for those before you” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for kataba as obligation.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Naught befalleth us save that which Allah hath decreed for us. He is our Protecting Friend. In Allah let believers put their trust!

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Nas neće pogoditi ništa osim onoga što nam je Allah propisao …‘“ – ar-Rāġib: ‚nama‘ (lanā), a ne ‚protiv nas‘, da bismo sve što nas pogodi smatrali blagodati.
explanation.en: “Say: Naught befalleth us save that which Allah hath decreed for us.” — ar-Rāġib: ‘for us’ (lanā), not ‘against us’, so that whatever befalls us is counted a favour.

quranTranslation.text: And when those who believe in Our revelations come unto thee, say: Peace be unto you! Your Lord hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that whoso of you doeth evil through ignorance and repenteth afterward thereof and doeth right, (for him) lo! He is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „… vaš Gospodar je Sebi propisao milost …“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib spominje ove riječi.
explanation.en: “… Your Lord hath prescribed for Himself mercy” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib mentions these words.

quranTranslation.text: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: „Sura koju smo objavili i učinili obaveznom …“ – ar-Rāġib: obavezali smo da se po njoj radi; on navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “(Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined” — ar-Rāġib: We made acting on it binding; he cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The pilgrimage is (in) the well-known months, and whoever is minded to perform the pilgrimage therein (let him remember that) there is (to be) no lewdness nor abuse nor angry conversation on the pilgrimage. And whatsoever good ye do Allah knoweth it. So make provision for yourselves (Hereafter); for the best provision is to ward off evil. Therefore keep your duty unto Me, O men of understanding.

explanation.bs: „… pa ko u njima sebi odredi hadž …“ – ar-Rāġib: ko sebi utvrdi obavljanje hadža; čin je pripisan čovjeku, jer on određuje vrijeme.
explanation.en: “… whoever is minded to perform the pilgrimage therein” — ar-Rāġib: whoever fixes upon himself the performance of the pilgrimage; the act is ascribed to the person, for he sets its time.

quranTranslation.text: If ye divorce them before ye have touched them and ye have appointed unto them a portion, then (pay the) half of that which ye appointed, unless they (the women) agree to forgo it, or he agreeth to forgo it in whose hand is the marriage tie. To forgo is nearer to piety. And forget not kindness among yourselves. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „… a već ste im odredili vjenčani dar …“ – ar-Rāġib: imenovali ste im mehr i time ga sebi obavezali.
explanation.en: “… and ye have appointed unto them a portion” — ar-Rāġib: you named a dowry for them and so bound yourselves to it.

quranTranslation.text: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.

explanation.bs: „I putokaze; a po zvijezdi se oni upravljaju.“ – zvijezda kao putokaz; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.” — the star as a guide; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who hath set for you the stars that ye may guide your course by them amid the darkness of the land and the sea. We have detailed Our revelations for a people who have knowledge.

explanation.bs: „On vam je dao zvijezde da se po njima upravljate u tminama kopna i mora …“ – zvijezde koje izlaze i zalaze služe za put.
explanation.en: “He it is Who hath set for you the stars that ye may guide your course by them amid the darkness of the land and the sea” — the stars that rise and set serve the way.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;

explanation.bs: „Mi smo najbliže nebo ukrasili ukrasom – sjajnicama.“ – vidljive, blistave zvijezde; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets [kawākib]” — the visible, shining stars; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: When the planets are dispersed,

explanation.bs: „i kad se sjajnice raspu“ – ono što je krasilo nebo rasuto je na Sudnjem danu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “When the planets [kawākib] are dispersed” — what adorned the sky is scattered on the Last Day; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.

explanation.bs: „… ili ću vam donijeti plamen uzet od nje, da se ugrijete“ – plamen iz vatre, prvo značenje koje ar-Rāġib daje.
explanation.en: “or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves” — a flame taken from a fire, the first sense ar-Rāġib gives.

quranTranslation.text: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

explanation.bs: „osim onoga ko nešto ugrabi – njega progoni plamen probojni“ – plamen koji se javlja na nebu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.” — the flame that appears in the sky; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

explanation.bs: „Nema smetnje slijepome, ni hromome, ni bolesnome …“ – doslovna sljepoća; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick” — literal blindness; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: The blind man is not equal with the seer;

explanation.bs: „Ne mogu se izjednačiti slijepi i onaj koji vidi“ – sljepoća za istinu naspram uvida.
explanation.en: “The blind man is not equal with the seer” — blindness to the truth as against insight.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso is blind here will be blind in the Hereafter, and yet further from the road.

explanation.bs: „Ko je u ovom životu slijep, slijep će biti i na Ahiretu, i još dalje od pravog puta“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet i za drugo aʿmā donosi dva mišljenja: isti particip ili ‚sljeplji‘.
explanation.en: “Whoso is blind here will be blind in the Hereafter, and yet further from the road” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah and gives two views of the second aʿmā: the same participle or ‘blinder’.

quranTranslation.text: And will make him a messenger unto the Children of Israel, (saying): Lo! I come unto you with a sign from your Lord. Lo! I fashion for you out of clay the likeness of a bird, and I breathe into it and it is a bird, by Allah's leave. I heal him who was born blind, and the leper, and I raise the dead, by Allah's leave. And I announce unto you what ye eat and what ye store up in your houses. Lo! herein verily is a portent for you, if ye are to be believers.

explanation.bs: „… i iscjeljujem slijepog od rođenja i gubavog, i oživljavam mrtve, s Allahovom dozvolom …“ – Isaove riječi; čudo je s Allahovom dozvolom.
explanation.en: “I heal him who was born blind, and the leper, and I raise the dead, by Allah's leave” — Jesus' words; the miracle is by Allah's leave.

quranTranslation.text: When Allah saith: O Jesus, son of Mary! Remember My favour unto thee and unto thy mother; how I strengthened thee with the holy Spirit, so that thou spakest unto mankind in the cradle as in maturity; and how I taught thee the Scripture and Wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel; and how thou didst shape of clay as it were the likeness of a bird by My permission, and didst blow upon it and it was a bird by My permission, and thou didst heal him who was born blind and the leper by My permission; and how thou didst raise the dead by My permission; and how I restrained the Children of Israel from (harming) thee when thou camest unto them with clear proofs, and those of them who disbelieved exclaimed: This is naught else than mere magic;

explanation.bs: Allah podsjeća Isaa na Svoju blagodat: s Njegovom dozvolom iscjeljivao je slijepog od rođenja i gubavog – ista riječ u Allahovom obraćanju.
explanation.en: Allah reminds Jesus of His favour: by His permission he healed the one born blind and the leper — the same word in Allah's address.
